content:
Repair this Verilog 2001 AXI-stream width adapter with local edits.
S_KEEP_ENABLE=0 means the source has no byte-validity qualifier: all source bytes
are valid regardless of the value on s_axis_tkeep. M_KEEP_ENABLE=1 requires a
correct output byte-valid mask, including partially filled words at TLAST.
Preserve enabled-TKEEP behavior, frames, data, ID/DEST/USER and ready/valid flow.
Keep license, module parameters, ports, directives and bus-width assertions
byte-identical. Do not add initial blocks, system tasks, timing delays, modules,
or testbench access. Return up to 12 exact uniquely-occurring before/after edits
against the ORIGINAL source, with before snippets <=600 and after <=1200 chars.
No known patch or reference source is supplied. Independent simulation and a
bounded reference comparison will check the result.
Required JSON output schema:
{"type": "object", "properties": {"edits": {"type": "array", "minItems": 1, "maxItems": 12, "items": {"type": "object", "properties": {"before": {"type": "string"}, "after": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["before", "after"], "additionalProperties": false}}, "explanation": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["edits", "explanation"], "additionalProperties": false}
